title: data/vulns.json
description: Every CVE in the CISA KEV catalogue, plus every CVE named in a published report.

kev_date_added.description: When CISA added the CVE to KEV. Null when the CVE is not in KEV and appears only in reports.

ransomware.description: KEV's known-ransomware flag: true for Known, false for Unknown, null when the CVE is not in KEV.

actors.description: Resolved actors of the reports that name the CVE.

report_count.description: Published reports that name the CVE.

actorId.description: An ATT&CK group ID such as G0007, or a lower-case ASCII slug for an actor ATT&CK does not track. The ID is also the actor's file name and URL segment, so it has no colons, slashes or spaces, and it is never 'index'.

cve.description: A CVE ID in upper case.

nullableDate.description: A date, or null when none is known.

nullableLabel.description: A label, or null when no source gives one.
